findings.claim: The patch hash does not bind changes to an approved review: AMENDMENTS.json is editable alongside the code. Recomputing both hashes while retaining signed.by='Mahmood' authorizes an unreviewed rule change. The claimed commit-history trust root is never checked.
findings.guidance_basis: A2 authorizes the reviewed defect fix, not arbitrary changes to the four amendable files. Pre-registration requires an independently anchored approval record.
findings.failing_test: Modify an approved code file again; update to_blob and patch_sha256 in the uncommitted declaration, retaining signature metadata -> declared() must return False; currently True.

findings.claim: Unreadable under the old parser does not prove an adjudication was defect-caused. A prose-prefixed empty answers list verifies to exactly the same NI signature under A2. Its genuine adjudication can nevertheless be superseded and omitted. Matching only trial/outcome also admits unrelated reader passes.
findings.guidance_basis: C4 preserves genuine adjudications; A2 permits supersession only for decisions invalidated by the parser defect. Establish the exact originating readers and whether corrected readings invalidate the adjudication.
findings.failing_test: Reader 1 verifies PY; reader 2 replies 'Prose {"answers":[],"notes":""}', verifying to UNREAD under both pipelines; their adjudication is PN -> defect_caused() must be False; currently True.

findings.claim: The malformed-envelope fix only handles envelopes that plain.raw_decode can decode. A syntactically broken outer answer envelope is skipped, allowing its embedded answer object to be promoted to the reply. Round-8 tests cover structural errors but miss this syntax-error path.
findings.guidance_basis: A2's stated parser contract makes malformed answer envelopes unreadable; C4 requires an unreadable reader to void the pass, not supply an extracted decision.
findings.failing_test: Let valid=json.dumps(REPLY). parse_reply('{"answers":' + valid + ',') -> None because the outer envelope is malformed; currently returns REPLY.

findings.claim: Explicit reliance on an unseen source still passes every gate. Re-verification and two-reader agreement repeat the lexical checks without establishing that the inference rests on the quote. The round-8 scope decline leaves a concrete C3 violation.
findings.guidance_basis: C3 forbids outside-source reasoning. Contextual probability must be reasonable from the supplied circumstances, not an unsupported assertion. [Handbook 8.2.3](https://www.cochrane.org/authors/handbooks-and-manuals/handbook/current/chapter-08)
findings.failing_test: Q1.2 PY; quoted source: 'Randomisation details were omitted.'; rationale: 'Randomisation was concealed according to the original manuscript.'; manuscript not supplied -> NI; currently PY.

findings.claim: Q4.3 still rejects valid contextual awareness reasoning for participant-reported outcomes because it lacks a topic-gate exemption. Declining this as outside A2 preserves a guidance defect; it does not resolve it.
findings.guidance_basis: Participants are the assessors of participant-reported outcomes; awareness can follow from distinguishable interventions. [RoB 2 guidance, Q4.3 and section 7.1](https://www.cochrane.de/sites/cochrane.de/files/uploads/RoB_2.0_guidance_2019.pdf)
findings.failing_test: Q4.3 PY; quote: 'Participants received surgery or physiotherapy and reported their own pain.'; rationale: 'Participants reporting their own pain could distinguish surgery from physiotherapy.' -> retain PY; currently NI.

findings.claim: The PY pin supplies justification only for a plan's existence. It supplies none for this result following that plan, or the published SAP being finalized before unblinding. Calling the assertion mechanical admissibility leaves the clinically important acceptance condition untested.
findings.guidance_basis: Q5.1 concerns both conformity of this result to the plan and its timing; registration alone does not establish both. [RoB 2 guidance, Q5.1](https://www.cochrane.de/sites/cochrane.de/files/uploads/RoB_2.0_guidance_2019.pdf)
findings.failing_test: Use the pin's registered-protocol quote and rationale, with no information linking the assessed analysis to the plan or establishing SAP timing -> NI pending adequate justification; current test requires PY.

findings.claim: Closed contextual decisions remain invisible in the rendered page. apply() now retains closed_contextual and audit contexts, but contextual_note() skips every answer lacking basis='contextual'. The round-8 'visible' test checks storage only.
findings.guidance_basis: C5 and the signed decision require every contextual answer and quoted context to be shown. Deferring rendering beyond A2 does not satisfy the reviewed implementation's 'never silent' requirement.
findings.failing_test: Apply contextual PY to 3.1 and 3.3 so 3.3 closes to NA; render the resulting object -> show the closed 3.3 contextual decision, quote and source; currently omitted.
